[P1] 大脚丫跳芭蕾
文／图：〔美〕埃米·扬 翻译：柯倩华
河北教育出版社

[P2] 大脚丫跳芭蕾
文／图〔美〕埃米·扬 翻译 柯倩华
河北教育出版社

[P3] 有一个跳芭蕾舞的女孩名叫贝琳达。

[P4] 贝琳达喜欢跳舞。她每天去舞蹈学校，
认真地练舞。她跳舞的时候，姿态优雅、脚
步轻巧灵活。

[P5] 可是，贝琳达有个大问题，嗯，
应该说有两个大问题：

就是她的左脚和右脚。

[P6] 其实贝琳达不觉得自己的脚有问题，可是参加一年一度的芭蕾舞表演选拔时，问题就来了。

[P7] 评审委员一看到她的脚就大叫：
“暂停！”

[P8] “天啊！”贾庄董男爵三世说，“你的脚大得像条船！”
著名的纽约评论家乔治·根毕崇说：“简直和海豹的鳍没两样！”
常在舞蹈杂志上发表文章的欧娜·劳乌柏女士瞪着眼睛直摇头。
贝琳达还没试跳，评审们就说：“回去吧。你那一双脚，永远跳不好！”

[P9] 贝琳达很难过，难过了好久好久。

[P10] 她想：“或许那些评审委员说得对，我的大脚真的不适合跳舞。”

[P11] 于是，贝琳达不跳舞了。

她告诉自己：“我放弃跳芭蕾舞吧。”

费莱迪餐厅
征人启事
室内乐团！
即将登场！

既然不再跳舞，她就得找别的事做。可是，她除了跳舞，什么都不会。她找啊找，终于在费莱迪餐厅找到工作。

[P12] 餐厅里的
客人喜欢她，
因为她动作
快、脚步轻
巧灵活。

费莱迪先生也
喜欢她，因为她做
事很认真。

[P13] 贝琳达喜欢费莱迪先生和餐厅里的
客人，不过她还是忘不了跳舞。

[P14] 有一天，有个乐团来餐厅
表演。他们自称“费莱迪
好友乐团”。在餐厅开门
营业前，他们先练了
一首轻快的曲子。

[P15] 贝琳达的脚尖忍不住一上一下地跟着打拍子。

[P16] 接着，他们开始演奏浪漫又抒情的乐曲，不知不觉中……
贝琳达跳起舞来了！

[P17] 这些音乐家每天到餐厅演奏，贝琳达每天
趁客人还没上门，就随着他们的音乐跳舞。

有一天，费莱迪先生问贝琳达愿不愿意跳
给客人看。贝琳达微笑着回答：“噢，当然好啊！”

[P18] 餐厅里的客人都很喜欢她的表演。他们高兴地去告诉他们的朋友，那些朋友第二天就来到费莱迪餐厅。

他们也非常喜欢……

[P19] 他们又告诉其他朋友。很快地，每天都有很多人来费莱迪餐厅看贝琳达跳舞。

[P20] 大都会芭蕾舞团的指挥听说了这件事，他的朋友的朋友叫他一定要去看贝琳达跳舞。他去了。

[P21] 他很惊讶。
他非常赞赏。
他觉得好感动。

[P22] “你一定要来大都会剧院表演！”他激动地说，“请你答应我！”
贝琳达笑着回答：
“噢，当然好啊！”餐厅里的客人都鼓掌欢呼起来。

[P23] 就这样，贝琳达到了大都会剧院，随着“费莱迪好友乐团”美妙的音乐翩翩起舞。她好喜欢跳舞！评审委员们大喊：“太精彩了！多么像燕子、鸽子、羚羊啊！”
他们全神贯注地看她跳舞，完全没有注意到她的脚有多大。

[P24] 贝琳达快乐极了。因为她可以跳舞，
跳舞，

[P25] 一直跳舞。

[P26] 至于评审委员们说什么，她一点也不在乎了！

[P1] Big Feet Dancing Ballet
Text & Illustrations: [USA] Amy Young  Translator: Ke Qianhua
Hebei Education Press

[P2] Big Feet Dancing Ballet
Text & Illustrations by [USA] Eric Carle, Translated by Ke Qianhua
Hebei Education Press

[P3] There was a girl who danced ballet, and her name was Bellinda.

[P4] Belinda loves to dance. She goes to dance school every day,
practicing diligently. When she dances, her posture is graceful and her steps are light and nimble.

[P5] But, Bellinda had a big problem, well,
should say two big problems:

Her left foot and her right foot.

[P6] Actually, Bellinda didn't think there was anything wrong with her feet, but when she participated in the annual ballet performance audition, the problem arose.

[P7] The judges screamed as soon as they saw her feet:
"Stop!"

[P8] "Oh my!" said Lord Brindle III, "Your feet are as big as a boat!"
Famous New York critic George Root said, "They're just like a seal's flippers!"
Ms. Ona Lawup, who often writes for dance magazines, stared with her eyes wide and shook her head.
Before Belinda even tried to dance, the judges said, "Go back. Those feet of yours will never be good for dancing!"

[P9] Belle was very sad, and she stayed sad for a long, long time.

[P10] She thought: “Maybe the judges were right. My big feet really aren’t suited for dancing.”

[P11] So, Belinda stopped dancing.

She told herself, "I'll give up ballet." 

Freddy's Restaurant
Help Wanted
Indoor Band!
Coming Soon!

Since she no longer danced, she had to find something else to do. But, besides dancing, she couldn't do anything. She searched and searched, and finally found a job at Freddy's Restaurant.

[P12] The guests in the restaurant liked her,
because she moved quickly and had light, agile steps.

Mr. Freddie also liked her,
because she was very serious and careful in her work.

[P13] Belinda liked Mr. Freddy and the customers in the restaurant, but she still couldn't forget dancing.

[P14] One day, a band came to the restaurant
for a performance. They called themselves the "Freddy
Friends Band". Before the restaurant opened for business,
they practiced a light and cheerful tune.

[P15] Belinda's toes couldn't help but tap along to the beat, up and down.

[P16] Then, they began to play a romantic and expressive piece of music. Unknowingly...
Belinda started dancing!

[P17] These musicians came to the restaurant every day to perform, and Belinda danced along to their music every day before the guests arrived.

One day, Mr. Freddy asked Belinda if she would like to dance for the guests. Belinda smiled and replied, "Oh, of course!"

[P18] The customers in the restaurant all loved her performance. They happily told their friends, and those friends came to Freddie's restaurant the next day.

They also loved it very much……

[P19] They told other friends. Soon, every day many people came to Freddy's restaurant to watch Belinda dance.

[P20] The conductor of the Metropolitan Ballet heard about this. His friend's friend told him he had to go see Belinda dance. He went.

[P21] He was very surprised.
He admired her greatly.
He felt deeply moved.

[P22] "You must come perform at the Metropolitan Theater!" he said excitedly, "Please promise me!"
Belinda smiled and replied:
"Oh, of course!" The guests in the restaurant clapped and cheered.

[P23] And so, Belinda arrived at the Metropolitan Theater, dancing gracefully to the beautiful music of the 'Freddie's Friends Band.' She loved dancing! The judges shouted, 'Amazing! She's like a swallow, a dove, a gazelle!'
They were completely absorbed in watching her dance, not noticing at all how big her feet were.

[P24] Belinda was overjoyed. Because she could dance,
dance,

[P25] Keep dancing.

[P26] As for what the judges said, she didn't care at all!
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《大脚丫跳芭蕾》的封面，展示了一位穿着粉色芭蕾舞裙、脚踩大脚丫舞鞋的舞者正在优雅起舞，下方标注了作者、译者和出版社信息。
[P2] 本页为绘本《大脚丫跳芭蕾》的封面，画面中红色幕布旁露出一位舞者的小脸和舞鞋，背景为明亮的黄色，书名及作者、译者、出版社信息清晰可见。
[P3] 本页介绍了一个名叫贝琳达的女孩，她热爱跳芭蕾舞，画面中她穿着粉色舞裙，脚踩大脚丫舞鞋，优雅地站立在黄色舞台上。
[P4] 本页描述了贝琳达热爱跳舞，每天去舞蹈学校认真练习，跳舞时姿态优雅、步伐轻巧灵活。画面展示了她在把杆旁练习以及三个不同的舞蹈动作。
[P5] 本页指出贝琳达跳舞时面临的主要问题——她的双脚太大，画面中她双手叉腰，表情略显无奈，突显了她对大脚的困扰。
[P6] 本页描述了贝琳达在参加一年一度的芭蕾舞表演选拔时，她脚大的问题开始显现，画面中她从舞台侧幕探出头，观众席上的人们正注视着舞台。
[P7] 评审委员在看到贝琳达的大脚后，立刻大叫‘暂停！’，表现出震惊和拒绝的态度。
[P8] 贝琳达在芭蕾舞选拔中还未开始表演，评审们就因她巨大的脚而嘲笑并拒绝她，认为她永远跳不好芭蕾舞。
[P9] 贝琳达因被拒绝参加芭蕾舞选拔而感到非常难过，独自在浴缸里哭泣，画面表现了她悲伤的情绪。
[P10] 贝琳达站在镜子前，看着自己巨大的脚，内心开始怀疑评审委员的话，认为自己的大脚可能真的不适合跳舞。
[P11] 贝琳达因被拒绝参加芭蕾舞选拔而放弃跳舞，她决定寻找其他工作，并最终在费莱迪餐厅找到了一份工作。
[P12] 贝琳达在费莱迪餐厅工作，客人喜欢她动作快、脚步轻巧灵活，费莱迪先生也喜欢她做事认真。
[P13] 贝琳达在费莱迪餐厅工作，虽然喜欢这里的人，但内心仍无法忘记跳舞，画面中她托腮凝视，桌上放着一本舞蹈杂志。
[P14] 一天，一个名为“费莱迪好友乐团”的乐队来到餐厅，在营业前练习了一首轻快的曲子。
[P15] 贝琳达在餐厅工作时，听到乐队练习的音乐，她的脚尖忍不住随着节奏上下打拍子，表现出她内心对舞蹈的渴望。
[P16] 乐队演奏浪漫抒情的音乐，贝琳达在不知不觉中跳起了舞，画面中她轻盈地跃起，手持餐具，展现出对舞蹈的热爱。
[P17] 音乐家们每天在餐厅演奏，贝琳达趁客人未到时随音乐起舞。一天，费莱迪先生邀请她为客人跳舞，她欣然同意。
[P18] 贝琳达在餐厅为客人跳舞，受到热烈欢迎，客人们纷纷告诉朋友，第二天便有更多人前来观看。
[P19] 贝琳达在费莱迪餐厅为客人跳舞，受到热烈欢迎，客人们纷纷告诉朋友，导致每天都有很多人前来观看。
[P20] 大都会芭蕾舞团的指挥听说了贝琳达在餐厅跳舞的事，被朋友的朋友推荐后，他专程前来观看。
[P21] 大都会芭蕾舞团的指挥观看贝琳达在餐厅跳舞，被她的舞姿深深打动，表现出惊讶、赞赏和感动的情绪。
[P22] 大都会芭蕾舞团的指挥邀请贝琳达去剧院表演，她欣然答应，餐厅里的客人们为她鼓掌欢呼。
[P23] 贝琳达在大都会剧院的舞台上随乐队音乐起舞，评审们被她的舞姿深深吸引，赞叹不已，完全忽略了她脚大的特点。
[P24] 贝琳达因能跳舞而感到非常快乐，画面中她穿着粉色舞裙，正在开心地跳舞。
[P25] 贝琳达穿着粉色芭蕾舞裙，在空中优雅地跳跃，画面下方写着“一直跳舞”，表达她对舞蹈的持续热爱与享受。
[P26] 贝琳达在聚光灯下抱着一束红玫瑰，面带微笑，表现出她对评审意见的完全不在乎，享受着舞蹈带来的成功与快乐。
[P27] 画面中，贝琳达穿着粉色舞裙，怀抱一束红玫瑰，面带微笑，被一个心形边框包围，背景为粉红色，表现出她对舞蹈成功的喜悦与满足。
